data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided 2x2 guide image into a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet. Keep the exact 2 rows by 2 columns layout and the same overall canvas framing, but REMOVE all guide lines, borders, labels, and safe-area marks. Use only the cell placement and centering from the guide. Create four centered animation frames of a universal special-card trigger effect in an ocean fantasy theme, elegant and readable at small card size.

Background outside the FX must be solid #FF00FF (magenta), flat and uniform.

Each frame must be centered in its cell, consistent scale, and contained well within the central 65% of each cell with nothing crossing cell edges.

Effect style: pearl tide bloom, not an explosion. Circular chrysanthemum-like light rays mixed with gentle wave rings, soft glow, refined water magic.

Frame 1: small white pearl light at center with a faint blue ripple.
Frame 2: pearl-white and turquoise rays unfolding like flower petals, delicate wave ring expansion.
Frame 3: full tide-bloom halo, layered wave rings, fine radial beams, tiny pearl sparkles.
Frame 4: beams dissolving into a thin water ripple with a few small bubbles, fading gently.

Strictly effect only: no playing card, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no UI, no text, no icons. Clean HD ocean fantasy card-game FX sprite sheet, crisp, luminous, and readable.
